The plot illustrates the change in WER (Word Error Rate) over the course of fine-tuning. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and exhibits a linear scale ranging from 25 to 42.5, with tick marks every 2.5 units. A line in orange with circular markers and a solid line style represents "small AdaLoRA_int4", starting at a WER of approximately 37.4 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 25.2 at epoch 6. A line in pink with circular markers and a solid line style represents "small int8", beginning at a WER value of roughly 33.1 at epoch 0 and decreasing to approximately 26.5 at epoch 6. Finally, a line in orange with circular markers and a dashed line style represents "small AdaLoRA_int8", starting at a WER of approximately 30.1 at epoch 0 and declining to a WER value of around 23.1 at epoch 6.
